about_the_game:
A razor-edged cyber-noir soundtrack for late-night codebreakers.

Composed by Pau Damià Riera, the NETBREAK Original Soundtrack feel like late-night terminals, CCTV snow, and the quiet space before a crime goes wrong. He delivered a lean, moody score built for headphones and dim rooms.

What it sounds like.

  • Slow, heartbeat pulse, that keeps the tension moving without getting in the way.

  • Deep sub-bass and low, rounded synths that sit under everything instead of shouting over it.

  • Detuned, misty pads and drones for that “neon rain on glass” vibe.

  • Clicks, ticks, and tiny glitch hits, like keys, relays, or a distant hard drive, used as percussion instead of big drums.

  • Sparse minor-key motifs on a thin, glassy lead, simple figures that feel more like codes being entered than melodies being “sung.”

  • Gentle filter sweeps and sidechain “breathing” that make the whole thing inhale/exhale while you play.

If you like your horror with wires and fingerprints, this OST keeps the room cold and the cursor blinking.
